title: A staged segment file is no longer removed when the final UPDATE fails for a non-outage reason
notes: In Worker.upload, os.Remove(name) moved after the UPDATE and only the IsAway error returns before it. A non-away error now leaves the file on disk until the job's working directory is cleaned up. Alternative: remove the file only on success or on errWaiting. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
